title: Visible history, CLI and MCP
steps: Open Garden plan and run Show history of this note (⌘⇧P). An agent named Gardener made two changes after the seed. Click one to see its diff.
Set the author filter to Gardener and press Undo all: both edits go, as one change each by you. Redo on an undo puts it back.
Edit a note, pause, and your change shows up at the top as yours. Show history of everything lists changes to every note.

From a terminal in a checkout: `COMMON_INK_URL=<this Preview> bin/common-ink history`, `bin/common-ink cat 'Garden plan.md'`, `echo hi | bin/common-ink write Hello.md`. The CLI writes as the agent CLI, working for you.
Add `<this Preview>/mcp?agent=Claude` as an HTTP MCP server in an MCP client. Its tools are list_files, read_file, write_file, history and undo, and its changes show up in history as Claude's.
